title: Audit current structure and functional status for Codex review
description: Perform an audit-only inspection of the current ZhongWenHub implementation. Report the actual repository/backend structure, working, partial, broken, missing and unverified functions by role, migration/route/CI/mock risks, then push exactly two evidence files on a dedicated audit branch and open a Draft PR for Codex review.
required_audit_areas: EF contexts, migrations and model snapshot
runtime routes and frontend API contracts
backend build, unit and integration tests
frontend lint, tests and production build
acceptance_criteria: Every function has one allowed status and concrete evidence
Working status requires real API and persistence evidence where applicable
Blocked, skipped and unexecuted tests are not reported as passed
Known migration, route, baseline, stale-script and CI hypotheses are explicitly validated or rejected
Actual and target structures are compared path by path
Defects include severity, location, reproduction, expected and actual behavior
Only the two required audit output files are committed
The audit branch is pushed and a Draft PR is opened for Codex review
safety_constraints: Audit only; do not modify production code, tests, workflows, migrations or configuration
Never write to ZhongWenHub_Dev or production services
Never run manual DDL or edit migration history
Never commit secrets, credentials, tokens, dumps, private data or large raw logs
Never force-push, merge or update main
Never weaken tests or rewrite baselines to hide failures
Never claim Codex approval before independent review
